absenceSemantics.confirmed_no_service: An applicable authoritative schedule proves no service.
absenceSemantics.not_observed: A bounded booking observation found no sellable execution.
absenceSemantics.unknown: Coverage is missing, stale, rights-blocked, or insufficient.

notCovered.el: Δεν καλύπτεται κανένας πραγματικός Έλληνας μεταφορέας. Η Aloria είναι επινοημένη περιοχή.
notCovered.en: No real Greek operator is covered. Aloria is an invented region.
notCovered.sq: Asnjë operator real grek nuk mbulohet. Aloria është një rajon i shpikur.

notCovered.el: Οι θέσεις οχημάτων σε πραγματικό χρόνο και οι καθυστερήσεις δεν καλύπτονται.
notCovered.en: Real-time vehicle positions and delays are not covered.
notCovered.sq: Pozicionet e automjeteve në kohë reale dhe vonesat nuk mbulohen.

notCovered.el: Οι ναύλοι, όπου υπάρχουν, είναι ενδεικτικοί και ποτέ προσφορά.
notCovered.en: Fares are indicative where present and are never a quotation.
notCovered.sq: Çmimet, aty ku ekzistojnë, janë tregues dhe kurrë një ofertë.

notCovered.el: Η απουσία δρομολογίου δεν αποδεικνύει ότι δεν εκτελείται δρομολόγιο.
notCovered.en: Absence of a journey is not proof that no service operates.
notCovered.sq: Mungesa e një udhëtimi nuk provon se nuk kryhet asnjë shërbim.

note.el: Αυτή η έκδοση περιέχει ένα επινοημένο σύνολο δεδομένων επίδειξης για τη φανταστική περιοχή Aloria. Κανένα στοιχείο δεν περιγράφει πραγματική αναχώρηση.
note.en: This release carries an invented demonstration dataset for the fictional region of Aloria. No row describes a real departure.
note.sq: Ky version përmban një grup të dhënash demonstrimi të shpikura për rajonin e trilluar Aloria. Asnjë rresht nuk përshkruan një nisje reale.
